WorkLifecycleSyncTests.test_cleanup_help.note: On PostgreSQL a deleted Work's file is a managed object: the delete records an object_cleanup_claims row in its own transaction, and settling a claim re-checks live references, so a replay (answered from the ledger, with no path) can neither duplicate a claim nor remove a file another Work names. The SQLite pending_pdf_cleanup and cleanup_after_work_delete do not exist there.
